feed.title: Free small-business calculators — tools on marisstella.dev
feed.subtitle: The 516 free, browser-only tools served directly from marisstella.dev — the newest 40 of them listed here, newest first. No account, no upload: every number stays on your own device. The full catalogue is larger and lives at tools.marisstella.dev.
feed.rights: Tools are MIT-licensed. They are estimates and records to act on, not professional advice.

entry.title: A/B Test Significance Calculator — p-value, SRM, Bayesian and Sequential
entry.summary: Free A/B test significance calculator. Enter visitors and conversions to get the p-value, confidence interval, sample ratio mismatch check, Bayesian chance to beat control and an always-valid result for tests you peeked at. Plans sample size too. Nothing is uploaded.

entry.title: Ad Incrementality Test Analyzer — did your ads cause the sales?
entry.summary: Free ad incrementality calculator for geo and store holdout tests. Paste sales by region, name the test regions and the start date to get the incremental lift with an interval, incremental ROAS, profit after ad spend and the smallest lift your test could detect. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.
